rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when working out the value of a variable or expression.

example.english: How do we quantify this expression to find the unknown value?
example.traditional: 呢條式要點樣計算，先至搵到個未知數？
example.jyutping: ne1 tiu4 sik1 jiu3 dim2 joeng2 gai3 syun3 sin1 zi3 wan2 dou3 go3 mei6 zi1 sou3

rows.note: Use this colloquial construction when assigning a number or quantity to something.
Use this for assigning a numerical measure in technical, business, or analytical contexts rather than for calculating a value.

example.english: The company has started to quantify employees’ performance so it can compare departments.
example.traditional: 公司開始量化員工嘅工作表現，方便比較各部門。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 hoi1 ci2 loeng6 faa3 jyun4 gung1 ge3 gung1 zok3 biu2 jin6 fong1 bin6 bei2 gaau3 gok3 bou6 mun4
